title: GPREEMPT: GPU Preemptive Scheduling Made General and Efficient
problem: GPUs lack efficient, general-purpose preemption mechanisms, limiting multitasking and resource sharing in shared GPU environments. Existing preemption approaches are either architecture-specific or carry high performance overhead.
motivation: Efficient GPU preemption enables better resource utilization, improved quality-of-service, and concurrent execution of multiple workloads on shared GPUs.
method: GPREEMPT introduces a general preemption scheduling framework that implements efficient context switching via checkpoint-restore mechanisms and intelligent scheduling policies. The approach abstracts preemption across diverse GPU architectures and workload types to minimize overhead.
key_novelty: A unified GPU preemption mechanism that achieves both architectural generality and operational efficiency through abstraction-based scheduling.
contributions: General-purpose preemption framework supporting diverse GPU architectures
Efficient preemption with minimized context-switch overhead
Support for multiple workload types and concurrent execution models
